text:
Alex Rivera: Quick mid-quarter micro check — can each owner drop one-line status for their milestone (shipped / slipped / partial) + blockers and next steps? I'll compile for the OKR tracker.

Maya Chen: Telemetry cost-breakdown card (product) — partial. UX shipped, backend metrics hook is late. Owner: @Samir. Targeting alpha next week.

Samir Patel: @Maya correct — backend metrics hook slipped. Infra allocation for model routing telemetry got deprioritized for a hotfix. PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/metrics-hook/pull/67 please review.

Taylor Ng: Kernel selection rollout (eng-runtime) — shipped to canary, perf looks good on p3.2x but we still need a fallback path for older quantized builds. Owner: @Taylor. Next: A/B across regions.

Priya Das: Autoscaler for batch-scheduler (eng-infra) — blocked. The HPA changes require platform network policies update; filed infra ticket #8921 and waiting on net team. QA readiness paused.

Alex Rivera: Noted blockers: infra allocation + network policy. @Samir @Priya what's the ETA if we get allocation by EOD Monday?

Samir Patel: If allocation by EOD Mon, I can finish the metrics hook and run validation by Wed. That pushes alpha to Thu.

Priya Das: Network policy ETA uncertain — pinged infra on thread. If approved Mon, we can resume smoke tests Tue-Wed, target ready by Thu-Fri.

Maya Chen: Console cost-per-token analytics — slipped from M2 to M3. We can ship an opt-in alpha (limited accounts) in two weeks if infra gives the green light for metrics ingest.

Taylor Ng: Small ask: can product defer the rollout of regional A/B for one week if we roll kerner canary wider? I'd rather stabilize global kernel profile first.

Maya Chen: Fine with one-week deferral. We'll update roadmap.

Alex Rivera: Code review pings: @Samir please PTAL at the metrics PR (link above). @Taylor can you review the fallback shim PR (https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/fallback-shim/pull/903)? Quick approvals unblock canary -> prod. :eyes:

Samir Patel: On it — aiming to review today.

Taylor Ng: Will review tonight and flag any perf regressions.

Priya Das: QA note: when autoscaler resumes, please add these two test cases to the smoke-suite: 1) sustained burst 2) KV-cache warmup under batching. I'll add them to the test plan.

Alex Rivera: Dependencies summary for tracker: 
- Telemetry hook (owner Samir) -> blocked by infra allocation hotfix (ETA if allocated: Wed)
- Kernel selection (owner Taylor) -> canary shipped, need fallback shim review (PR 903)
- Cost analytics (owner Maya) -> slipped, alpha gated on metrics ingest
- Batch autoscaler (owner Priya) -> blocked by network policy (ticket #8921)

Next steps (TL;DR):
- @Samir finish metrics PR if allocation arrives (ETA Wed), Sam to update tracker.
- @Taylor review/ship fallback shim to allow wider canary.
- @Priya follow infra-net thread, update ETA; QA will queue tests on resume.
- @Maya update roadmap to push full console ship by M3, enable opt-in alpha if metrics available in two weeks.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary-kernel-rollout -> 2151239000 (automated window). Reaction: :shipit:.

Alex Rivera: Thanks everyone — I'll aggregate this into the OKR doc and ping execs with a concise status tomorrow. If anyone changes ETA, update the tracker or reply here. :thumbsup:
